explanation.question_quote: he presents with fine rales in both lungs, his abdomen is non-distended non-tender, and there is 2+ lower limb pitting edema up to his knees
explanation.sentence: He presents with orthopnea, bilateral fine rales, and pitting edema to the knees.
This combination points to acute decompensated heart failure with pulmonary and systemic congestion.
Intravenous furosemide is the best initial therapy to relieve congestion; the elevated BUN and creatinine do not establish volume depletion, and normal saline could worsen pulmonary congestion.
There is no evidence of shock to warrant norepinephrine or of hepatorenal syndrome to warrant terlipressin.
